flag provided but not defined: -bogus
Usage of measure:
  -ab
    	alias for --compare
  -c	alias for --compare
  -compare
    	A/B split-horizon vs public via --resolve (dns-host only; read-only)
  -n int
    	alias for --runs (default 5)
  -runs int
    	number of timed requests per leg (default 5)
  -w int
    	alias for --warmup (default 3)
  -warmup int
    	untimed warm-up requests before measuring (default 3)
